{
  "observation": "After I put the house keys and flashlight in the shallow compartment and closed it, the person pointed toward the lid without speaking.",
  "interpretation": "They may have wanted me to reopen it. The gesture alone didn’t tell me why.",
  "title": "",
  "note": "",
  "question": "When I put the keys and flashlight away in the entryway, do you usually want me to leave the compartment open?"
}
